title: Coherence of normalized shifted Tate-unit comparisons
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum of [def-pur-conventions], a prime $\ell\ne p$, a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $S$, finite coefficient extensions $\mathbf Q_\ell=E_0\subset E\subset F$ with their valuation rings [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and an integer $d\ge0$. Work on the small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site]. Put $R_L=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{L,S}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], $U_L=R_L[0]$, and $T_L=U_L(d)[2d]$, using [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Let $A=C_{E/E_0,S}$, $B=C_{F/E,S}$ and $D=C_{F/E_0,S}$ be ordinary derived coefficient extensions $C_{H/L,S}(K)=K\otimes^L_{R_L}R_H$ [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings], identified on derived-complete objects with the strict-tower extensions of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] by the specified natural comparison $\chi$ of [lem-weil-finite-free-completed-scalar-comparison]. Let $\alpha:BA\xrightarrow{\sim}D$ be the natural ordinary tensor associator, with this normalization under $\chi$.
For $L\subset H$ among the three fields let $u_{H/L}:C_{H/L,S}U_L\xrightarrow{\sim}U_H$ be the derived coefficient-unit multiplication: it is induced by the degree-zero module-sheaf map $x\otimes b\mapsto\iota_{H/L}(x)b$ and the canonical K-flat resolving comparison, where $\iota_{H/L}:R_L\to R_H$ is the coefficient inclusion. Let $s_{H/L,K,n}:C_{H/L,S}(K[n])\xrightarrow{\sim}(C_{H/L,S}K)[n]$ be the canonical shift comparison induced by termwise change of rings. Let $\beta_{H/L,K}:C_{H/L,S}(K(d))\xrightarrow{\sim}(C_{H/L,S}K)(d)$ be the specified natural twist comparison of [lem-weil-integral-twist-derived-scalar]. Define
$$q_{H/L}=(u_{H/L}(d)\circ\beta_{H/L,U_L})[2d]\circ s_{H/L,U_L(d),2d}:C_{H/L,S}T_L\xrightarrow{\sim}T_H.$$
The objects $U_L,T_L$ belong to the derived-complete integral constructible finite-Tor categories [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude]. The uniform Tor intervals of $U_L,T_L$ are respectively $[0,0]$ and $[-2d,-2d]$. Also $AT_0$ belongs to the same category at $E$. With $u_E=u_{E/E_0}$, $u_F=u_{F/E_0}$, $v=u_{F/E}$, $\theta_E=q_{E/E_0}$, $\theta_F=q_{F/E_0}$ and $a=q_{F/E}$, the specified maps satisfy
$$u_F\circ\alpha_{U_0}=v\circ B(u_E),\qquad \theta_F\circ\alpha_{T_0}=a\circ B(\theta_E).$$
These equalities use the canonical shift comparisons displayed above, and hold also for identity coefficient extensions.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-tate-unit-flat-model-domains] at each of $E_0,E,F$ with $m=d$, $n=2d$. It supplies the actual K-flat models, all derived-complete constructible finite-Tor memberships and the uniform containing intervals $[0,0]$ and $[-2d,-2d]$, with the specified comparison $\chi$.

source.place: Coefficient transport, assembly of retained old Steps 1-7; 1

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-unshifted-line-unit-tower] with $(L_0,L_1,L_2)=(E_0,E,F)$ and $m=d$. Its $u$ maps are exactly those in the statement, so its first equation is $u_F\alpha_{U_0}=vB(u_E)$. Put $w_{H/L}=u_{H/L}(d)\beta_{H/L,U_L}$; the same node gives the coherent unshifted $w$ tower and its specified unit normalization.

source.place: Coefficient transport, assembly of retained old Steps 1-7; 2

proof.text: Use [lem-pur-scalar-shift-line-tower-transport] on $K_L=U_L(d)$ and the isomorphisms $w$ of step 2, taking $n=2d$. By definition its maps $w[2d]s$ are the stated $q$. Its shifted equation is therefore $\theta_F\alpha_{T_0}=aB(\theta_E)$, for the actual completed normalization as well. Both this equation and the unit equation include repeated fields by the identity clauses of steps 2 and 3.

source.place: Coefficient transport, assembly of retained old Steps 1-7; 3

proof.text: Each $q$ is an isomorphism, hence $AT_0\cong T_E$ through $q_{E/E_0}$. Step 1 puts $T_E$ in the required category; the isomorphism closure of [lem-weil-integral-ctf-triangulated] puts $AT_0$ there. This completes all clauses, including $S=\varnothing$ and $d=0$.
